# Coordinates on the globe

> An interactive geography lesson about latitude and longitude for 6th graders, in English, Polish and Ukrainian. It has maps, a globe, a day and night lab, practice questions and printable sheets. The whole lesson is also one HTML file that works offline.

The lesson is a single-page app. Each link below opens the same page at a different place (hash routes). Replace `en` with `pl` for Polish or `uk` for Ukrainian.

## Lesson

- [Home](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/): the list of the ten topics, practice and tools
- [The globe grid](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-1/explore): Meridians, parallels, the equator and hemispheres
- [Where is it?](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-2/explore): North or south of a parallel, east or west of a meridian
- [Reading coordinates](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-3/explore): Find the latitude and longitude of a point
- [Finding a place](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-4/explore): Put a point on the map from its coordinates
- [Degrees and minutes](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-5/explore): One degree has 60 minutes
- [How many degrees apart?](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-6/explore): Differences in latitude and longitude
- [Distance along a meridian](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-7/explore): One degree is about 111.2 km
- [Longitude and time](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-8/explore): Day, night and local solar time
- [Coordinates in your phone](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-9/explore): Decimal coordinates, map apps and the Mercator map
- [Why we have seasons](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/topic-10/explore): The Earth's orbit, its tilted axis, solstices and equinoxes

## Tools

- [Day and night lab](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/lab): Move the Sun through the day and the year. Watch day and night travel around the Earth and see what time it is in different places.
- [Test rehearsal](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/rehearsal): 15 questions from all topics. You will see the answers at the end, just like after a real test.
- [Cheat sheet](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/cheatsheet): a printable summary of every rule
- [Worksheet](https://xsavikx.github.io/geo-coordinates/#en/worksheet): a printable worksheet with an answer key
